mission.name: IDC Forge 2.0.4 World-Class Trust and Utility
mission.tagline: Ship 2.0.4 with bounded content trust while preserving the stronger external-threshold mission as an unwaived later profile.
mission.northStar: A new consumer can reject a counterfeit repository without trusting it to define its own root; every parser, waiver, credential, provenance, platform, and release claim is independently recomputable.

policies.notes: The owner authorized stable 2.0.4 publication under the bounded public content-authenticated profile in docs/2.0.4-release-scope.md. GitHub remains canonical distribution; two out-of-repository publications must repeat the full Forge fingerprint and immutable release identity before promotion. This scoped publication does not close or waive the still-active production 2-of-3, complete Kimi, Windows/NTFS, freshness-authorized fleet, publication-observer, or readyToRun G1-G6 gates. No force-push, credential disclosure, evidence rewriting, or unrelated mutation is authorized.
